design_archetype.name: Swiss Precision & Tactical Telemetry
design_archetype.vibe: Command-center clarity, high-contrast operational status, dense scannable data grids, professional NOC monitoring interface

layout_and_grids.bento_dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 lg:gap-6
layout_and_grids.card_border: border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md rounded-xl shadow-lg
layout_and_grids.header_style: z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-slate-800 sticky top-0 shadow-sm

simulation_controls_panel.visibility: Always visible top-bar badge & control center drawer
simulation_controls_panel.badge_style: border border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-semibold tracking-wider animate-pulse

it_assistant.layout: Phone-friendly responsive form cards, quick status badges, action-heavy checklist matrix

network_engineer.layout: High-density multi-pane monitoring telemetry, Chart.js time-series charts, resolution modal forms

administrator.layout: Data tables with filtering, user status badges, action menus, audit event timeline

testing_and_accessibility.status_text_rule: Every status badge MUST display readable text alongside color indicators (e.g. 'DEGRADED (CONGESTION)' not just yellow dot)
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_min: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large display elements
testing_and_accessibility.last_updated_timestamp: Mandatory display on telemetry feeds in Asia/Manila format (PHT)

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow JS file format for component imports (React JavaScript codebase)
Use Shadcn UI components for dropdowns, dialogs, tabs, tables, toasts (sonner)
Use JetBrains Mono or monospace font for telemetry numbers, IP addresses, and timestamps
Ensure feed interruption clearly sets AP status to STALE/UNKNOWN rather than inferring an AP outage
Include simulated demo scenario controls banner at top of dashboard with interactive triggers
Implement idempotency feedback for checklist retries and display existing open ticket warning on duplicates
Include data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements, forms, and status cards
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic light SaaS visuals. Use rich dark slate textures with crisp status borders, explicit simulation badges, Asia/Manila timestamps, and responsive layouts for both mobile IT assistants and NOC engineers.
